quality_effect: Pins survey epoch, vertical datum, ground-truth age and transformation metadata before any LiDAR elevation can become parcel evidence.
official_facts: Time-stamped DTM is available at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m depending on project requirements.
Time-stamped DTM is supplied as GeoTIFF rasters in 5km zip files.
Elevation values are presented in metres.
Time-stamped DTM is referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn and aligned to the OS Grid.
EA states vertical accuracy of +/-15cm RMSE for the LiDAR data.
The transformation used is specific to the survey time period.
Metadata catalogues identify survey date, product resolution, transformation and geoidal model for a location.
Ground-truth records include survey date, surface type, survey method, transformation and geoidal models.
A ground-truth survey may be reused if less than 5 years old, or 3 years for coastal projects.
Timestamped LiDAR is compared with ground truth for RMSE, standard deviation and random error.
A matching point cloud does not necessarily exist for every historic DSM/DTM surface model.
